blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Mayor Nestor Archival expects Sinulog 2027 to be grander than last year’s festival, but said the city must balance rising operational costs with the expense and environmental impact of traditional fireworks. Archival said Monday, Oct. 5, that the city had started coordinating with the Sinulog Foundation Inc. (SFI) to organize the festival’s executive committee, which would determine key details including the number of contingents and other activities. The mayor said a larger contingent turnout would also require the city to spend more on operations, including assistance for participating groups. “Pag [daghan] ang contingents, dako ang resources nga […]...
